title: 23.34. Maggārammaṇattika, Kusalattika
note: Pāli only: every English translation of the Abhidhamma is still under copyright, so no English can be shown yet. A free translation will be added if one becomes available.

verses.t: Namaggārammaṇaṁ nakusalaṁ dhammaṁ paccayā maggārammaṇo kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. (Saṅkhittaṁ.)
Hetuyā pañcatiṁsa …pe… avigate pañcatiṁsa. (Naakusalaṁ naabyākataṁ natthi.)
